description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Glilot
Hybrid
Full-time

This is an 12-month temporary position, with potential for extension depending on business needs.

You'll join an R&D team that owns its systems end to end, from understanding the business need through design, implementation, and production monitoring. You'll build robust backend services that other teams rely on, and use AI tools in your daily work. You'll help shape how the team adopts them.

What you'll do:

- Take a leadership role in the design, architecture, development, quality, and production deployment of the team's systems.

- Design and implement scalable, maintainable backend solutions for complex scenarios, consumed by other teams.

- Work directly with Product, Design/UX, DevOps, and business stakeholders to understand the problem and define success metrics.

- Use AI-powered development tools daily to move faster, and help the team adopt them responsibly.

- Own production readiness: monitoring, alerting, and observability from day one, and lead the response to critical production issues.

- Lead by example in code quality and code reviews, and act as a focal point for engineering excellence.

- Proactively identify improvements in team systems, processes, and scalability.

Who you are:

Experience

- 7+ years in backend engineering, with a track record of handling technical trade-offs and ambiguity.

- Proficiency in C#, Java, or a similar object-oriented language.

- Strong SQL and database management skills.

- Hands-on experience with non-relational databases such as MongoDB.

- Experience with message queues or streaming platforms (e.g., RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka).

- Experience with microservices architecture.

- Experience extending complex existing systems while maintaining scalability and performance.

- Hands-on, daily use of AI development tools.

- A habit of validating before shipping: tests, metrics, and monitoring.

- Independence: you can take a problem from definition to production without detailed specs.

- Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders; you flag risks early.

- BA/BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience (e.g., military technology units like 8200).

Advantage:

- Integrating AI-driven capabilities (LLM calls, multi-step workflows, retrieval) into backend services where they add value.

- Deep familiarity with both Scrum and Kanban, or involvement in designing an AI-driven software development lifecycle.

- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Mentoring new hires and interns.

#LI-MP2

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Tailored for a law student with a technical background, this role provides direct integration into Palo Alto Networks' Intellectual Property practice group. You will gain hands-on, practical experience navigating complex legal matters in advanced cybersecurity contexts. Working directly under a Senior IP Counsel, you will operate at the intersection of IP strategy and legal operations, driving practical AI solutions to modernize internal workflows.
Core Responsibilities

- IP Strategy & Compliance: Partner with legal teams, product leadership, and engineering to identify patentable innovations, assess IP risk profiles, and maintain open-source software license compliance under the guidance of Senior IP Counsel.

- Initiative Ownership: Manage and execute multiple concurrent legal projects from early planning through execution.

- AI & Legal Operations Modernization: Drive legal tech innovation by configuring and managing internal AI solutions to optimize and automate legal team workflows.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements:

- Enrolled as a law student with a minimum of 18 months remaining prior to graduation.

- Analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.

- Fluent or high proficiency in English (written and verbal).

- High attention to detail with proven organizational skills to manage concurrent initiatives effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Background in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering or related technical disciplines.

- Demonstrated project management capability, with experience independently steering projects from concept to completion.

- Familiarity or practical experience with AI tools, workflow automation, or legal technology applications.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.
